title: Horizontal Carbon Steel Oil Storage Tank for Petrochemical Use
summary: Tongyang manufactures customized horizontal carbon steel oil storage tanks for petrochemical and industrial applications, featuring robust welded construction, protective coatings, and flexible vessel configurations.
body:
Horizontal Carbon Steel Oil Storage Tank

Product Overview

The Horizontal Carbon Steel Oil Storage Tank is a customized industrial storage vessel manufactured by Yangzhou Tongyang Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd. for petrochemical, oil processing, and general industrial applications.

Designed with a robust welded cylindrical shell, dished ends, reinforced supports, and customized nozzle connections, the tank provides reliable liquid storage and buffering for industrial processing systems.

Tongyang offers customized capacities, vessel dimensions, operating conditions, and protective coatings to meet individual project requirements. Both standard and project-specific configurations are available.

Key Features

  • Heavy-Duty Construction: Robust welded carbon steel structure for industrial applications.

  • Customized Design: Flexible tank capacities, dimensions, connections, and support arrangements.

  • Corrosion Protection: Protective exterior coatings available in yellow or other specified colors.

  • Flexible Connections: Optional inlet, outlet, drain, vent, manway, and instrumentation connections.

  • Manufacturing Quality: Controlled welding, dimensional inspection, and applicable non-destructive testing.

  • Reliable Installation: Horizontal configuration with engineered support structures.

Industrial Applications

Tongyang horizontal carbon steel storage tanks can be configured for a variety of applications, including:

  • Petrochemical Industry: Storage of compatible petroleum products and process liquids.

  • Oil & Gas Industry: Industrial oil handling and storage systems.

  • Chemical Manufacturing: Intermediate liquid storage and process buffering.

  • Industrial Facilities: Fuel oil, lubricating oil, and other compatible liquid storage applications.

Material compatibility, operating conditions, and safety requirements are evaluated according to the intended service.

Tongyang Manufacturing Capabilities

As a manufacturer of customized chemical processing equipment, Tongyang provides industrial storage tanks and pressure vessels designed around customer-specific requirements.

Our capabilities include carbon steel fabrication, welding quality control, surface treatment, dimensional inspection, and factory testing.

Customized solutions are available for tank capacity, material specifications, nozzle arrangements, supports, protective coatings, and applicable design standards.
